description: Create a new social media channel. Either pass platform credentials (Instagram and Twitter/X: the full session JSON including account, cookies, headers, and platform-specific tokens), or set postFrom='browser' with a handle to post from the user's own logged-in browser tab through the Neuron extension (Instagram, X and LinkedIn; no credentials needed).

credentials.description: Session credentials as JSON string with account, session.cookies, session.headers, etc.

handle.description: Account handle (X username, Instagram username, LinkedIn profile slug from linkedin.com/in/<slug>). Required with postFrom='browser'.

label.description: Display name for the channel (e.g., 'Brand IG Account')

platform.description: Social media platform: 'instagram', 'twitter' or 'linkedin' (linkedin needs postFrom='browser')

postFrom.description: 'browser' posts from the user's logged-in tab via the Neuron extension instead of stored credentials

name: neuron_create_social_channel
title: Create Social Channel
